Must-haves

Must

  • Old clips first
  • Say the missing step was physical care
  • Say how long you've used it
  • Glass skin close-up, bare skin, no filter
  • The product on screen in the last scene
  • Say the Korean original spicule serum did it

Don't

  • Brand or product name out loud. Say spicule serum
  • Needles, microneedling
  • Cured, healed
  • Other brand names
  • Unboxing
